feeds.title: Shared Notes Blog
feeds.description: Shared Notes is the winemaking joint-venture between wife and husband, Bibiana González Rave and Jeff Pisoni. Both have spent their entire lives focusing on the sensory details of smell and taste while making wine now they also look to do the same with single-farm sourcing & roasting of coffee. Read their blog to find more about wine tasting, reviews, reports, and more.

feeds.title: Paso Robles Wineries Blog
feeds.description: The Premiere Blog is about Wine Tasting in Paso Robles, Wine Industry news, insider's advice on wineries, wine pairing recipes for Central Coast Wine Country. Founded by a Paso Robles local wine lover and international traveller who wanted to offer a better and easier experience for visitors planning their trip. Our goal is to be your ultimate resource for your Paso Robles Wine Country visit. We're a knowledgeable and passionate group and will provide you with a map.

feeds.title: Wine Industry Advisor
feeds.description: The Wine Industry Advisor is an Online Industry Publication featuring news, articles, and editorial content relevant to the wine industry. WIN seeks to provide organizations and individuals with the tools and information to be successful in the wine industry.

feeds.title: Captain Vineyards Blog
feeds.description: Founded in Lamorinda, the San Francisco Bay Area, in 2005. We are a nano size, hand managed operation and will not scale beyond local means. We believe in our Terroir. That's why we refrain from adjustments, filtering or additives. We let the quality of the grape speak for itself. We are a family-owned, hand crafted, dry-farmed & green winery in Moraga, we offer tastings, tours and events.

feeds.title: Jordan Winery Blog
feeds.description: Our award-winning winery blog showcases life in Sonoma County wine country by sharing our passion for wine, winemaking, and the culinary arts. Jordan is a certified sustainable winery committed to wines and hospitality.

feeds.title: Uncorked Wine Shops Blog
feeds.description: With more than 600 wines from all over the world, Uncorked is a retail shop that features award-winning wines as well as hard-to-find boutique selections. For our hops and barley fans, Uncorked offers craft beers, both domestic and imported!

feeds.title: WineCountry.com Blog
feeds.description: WineCountry.com is more than just wine. It's about new experiences, community, and slowing down to savour life. We scour the region to present the best ideas and resources. Whether our users want to plan and daydream, live their adventure (or lounge by the pool), feel connected, or remember their visit, we have it covered.

feeds.title: Vinography
feeds.description: Vinography began on January 15th, 2004 as a personal project for founder and editor Alder Yarrow. The site is now a respected source for non-mainstream wine writing, and one of the most influential wine blogs on the Internet. Featuring wine and sake reviews, restaurant reviews, editorials, book reviews, wine news, and wine event coverage, Vinography publishes new content daily to a global readership.

feeds.title: Discover California Wines Blog
feeds.description: Discover California Wines is your go-to source to read about Wine, Food, Farm, and Finds. The blog shares a great range of published write-ups where you can discover all and everything about wine, the best food pairing with it, guides, and more.

feeds.title: Wine Blog » California
feeds.description: The following section of Wine Blog is dedicated to Californian Wines. Jo Diaz has worked in the wine industry since 1993. She has been employed by name famous names. And on her blog, Jo shares her experiences and announcements from the wine industry.

feeds.title: ENOFYLZ Wine Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Martin Redmond. I'm a Wine writer and this blog is my way of letting thoughts of wine off my mind and sharing it with family and friends. It's fun for me, and at times challenging to learn about wine. I've come to realize it's a passionate life-long love affair with wine.

feeds.title: Toast Tours Blog
feeds.description: Here at Toast Tours, they can think of no better way to bring people together than through the appreciation of world-class wines, beautiful views, and new experiences. Lars & Kristina are the people behind the creation of Toast Tours. They offer social group experiences of the world-class Paso Robles wine country and the extravagant Hearst Castle, as well as private group tours throughout the region. With them, you'll enjoy digging deeper into the area and the wine and will go home with the memory of a lifetime.

feeds.title: Halleck Vineyard Blog
feeds.description: Get the inside scoop on the best wine tasting in Sonoma, which is known for its cool climate wines, such as Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Syrah only on Halleck Vineyard Blog. We planted the Halleck Vineyard in 1993, the first in the hills of Sebastopol, in western Sonoma County. We were inspired to contribute and participate. We collaborate with charities to support our world. It's the most meaningful part of this work.

feeds.title: Cali Coast Wine Country Blog
feeds.description: Read Cali Coast Wine County to know all about California's Central Coast Wine Country, including Santa Barbara & San Luis Obispo. It was started by Liz who is a drinker, eater, and traveler. This site is all about tasting California's Central Coast: all the food, wineries, restaurants, and sparkling wine from Paso Robles, Avila Beach, and San Luis Obispo on down to Santa Barbara wine country: Santa Maria Valley, Los Alamos Valley, Foxen Canyon, Santa Lompoc and many more!

feeds.title: California Wines & Wineries
feeds.description: I am a member of the American Wine Society. I typically taste 1,500 wines a year. All the recommendations listed are wines that I have paid for and tasted. My focus is on showcasing small artisan and handcrafted wines of quality regardless of pricing. Quality wines are defined as having distinct layers and aromas that linger on the palate.

feeds.title: Appetite for Wine Blog
feeds.description: We enjoy wine. A lot. We are not wine professionals. We just enjoy tasting and drinking wine and exploring wine regions. We occasionally post reviews, musings, and thoughts about our experiences and the wines we enjoy. In this blog, we strive to delve deeper than the label or the contents of the bottle. We tell the story behind the wine.

feeds.title: California Winery Advisor
feeds.description: Find fun and practical advice on wine tasting, wine pairing, and wine travel. California Winery Advisor is a destination for wine travel enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Onehope Wine Blog
feeds.description: Covers wine facts, recipes, and experiences. Onehope is a lifestyle brand with a winery located in Napa Valley.

feeds.title: Exploring The Wine Glass Blog
feeds.description: Get all the behind the scenes conversations, stories, interviews with wine makers, wine reviews and more on the blog. Exploring the wine glass by Lori is a award winning wine review blog which gives all the insights related to wine making.

feeds.title: Sans Wine Co. Blog
feeds.description: At Sans Wine Co., we source organically grown grapes from old vine vineyards. Our wines are made naturally and are produced. All of our wines are certified vegan, contain no added sulfites and are fermented dry, with no residual (or added) sugar. We're the first producer of single vineyard, variety and vintage specific wines packaged in cans! Read our blog 'Without Pretense' and get our thoughts on the wine industry.

feeds.title: IWA Wine Country Blog
feeds.description: International Wine Accessories (IWA) is dedicated to helping our customers create a rich and cultured wine lifestyle. With decades of experience, our seasoned team of IWA wine and cellar specialists provides our valued customers with unparalleled access to the widest array of quality wine accouterments on the planet.

feeds.title: Wine Country Getaways Blog
feeds.description: This unique wine country website recommends which wineries are worth visiting and why. The site gives individual winery recommendations and maps out tours for visiting the best wineries in each California wine region.

feeds.title: The California Wine Club Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Uncorked Blog for all the detailed information, tips, tricks, facts, and activities on wine and many more! Gerri-Lynn Becker is the president of The California Wine Club. They believe that wine made by hand tastes better and thus helps people in finding the best artisans' wineries with them. Their mission is to only feature wines that they would proudly serve in their own home. They promise to only feature wines from real-working wineries which means no bulk wines and no private labels.

feeds.title: Winery-Sage Blog
feeds.description: Winery-Sage.com believes in thinking before drinking. It is an online encyclopedia of California wineries, varietals & regions. Winery-Sage has the most comprehensive online listing of California wines & wineries. Their blog offers wine, winery & product reviews & unique takes on different wines.

feeds.title: Vinopointer » California Wines
feeds.description: The Vinopointer Blog will inform you all about California wines and their flavors, also find reviews! They help people find out the best flavors of wine. Their goals are to help wine consumers sniff out good wines, and alert you to their presence. They are not just helping you find wines you will like but that too at a lesser price. They aim to find wines that are widely distributed and that represent exceptional values. They are committed to helping you find wines at less than half that price.

feeds.title: California Wine Tours & Transportation Blog
feeds.description: If you have got an inquisitive mind when it comes to wine then the California Wine Tour blog is just the right place for you! Read their blog articles for detailed information on Napa Valley Wine Tour, Sonoma Wine Tours, and Northern Sonoma Wine Tours. Since 1986, it has catered to the most discerning wine lovers and provided the most unique and personalized wine tours and wine tasting experiences that are fit for each client's preference and tastes. Whether you are a wine novice or a true connoisseur, we will integrate Wine Country's deep-rooted passions into your tour.

feeds.title: WineStyles Blog » California Wine
feeds.description: WineStyles Tasting Station is a new, innovative retail concept dedicated to simplifying wine, craft beers, and gourmet food through a unique, convenient, and affordable boutique shopping experience. Our wines are categorized into distinct style categories, such as crisp, silky, and rich for white wines and bold, mellow, and fruity for red wines, as well as bubbly for champagnes and nectar for dessert wines. They also categorize craft beer with their flavor style system!

feeds.title: Gold Medal Wine Club Blog
feeds.description: Our wine blog features our favorite regional & international wineries, new wine releases, & of course, the latest news at Gold Medal Wine Club.

feeds.title: The Napa Wine Project Blog
feeds.description: The Napa Wine Project is researched and maintained by David Thompson. The focus of this project is singular; a vehicle to educate and promote the Napa Valley, its vineyards, wines and stories, both domestically and internationally.

feeds.title: Temecula Valley Winegrowers Association Blog
feeds.description: The Temecula Valley Winegrowers Association is a nonprofit regional organization dedicated to promoting the growing and making of quality wine grapes and wine and the interests of wineries and vineyards in the Temecula Valley appellations. No matter which varietal of wine you're looking for, you can probably find it here! Known for our diversity, wineries here in the Temecula Valley grow and produce over 50 different varietals of wine.

feeds.title: Vinfolio Blog » California
feeds.description: The blog gives information on all the best, exclusive, rare, California wine! At Vinfolio, we're transforming how the fine wine community buys, sells, stores, and savors wine by bringing the perfect pairing to the table. We're connecting the world of fine wine in ways it's never been touched before. Our mission is to empower the fine wine community to perform at its best so that every bottle of fine wine reaches its fullest potential.

feeds.title: Vinfolio Blog
feeds.description: Blog topics cover wine collecting, investing, wine pairing, and Wineries. Vinfolio provides storage & cellar management services to the most discerning collectors of fine and rare wine.
